nodes.label: Run ffsubsync for all matching files in folder_path, updating sync_jobs[job_id] with per-file progress as each file completes.
Extract English subtitle from a specific MKV file. Returns the path to the extracted .en.srt file, or None if failed.
Look for an existing .en.srt in the folder. If not found, use the first MKV file and extract its English subtitle. Returns the path to the .en.srt file, or None if not possible.

Parse lines of the form `[ID] translated text`. Supports multi-line translations; stops each entry at the next `[ID]` on its own line, so trailing prose after the final entry is bounded by newline-breaks.
Translate a single subtitle file to Chinese. Returns True if successful, False otherwise.

Main entry point. Handles both single files and series folders. - If input_path is a file: translate its subtitle - If input_path is a folder: find all .en.srt, MKV, and MP4 files and translate their subtitles
Start an async sync job. Returns a job_id immediately; poll GET /sync/progress/{job_id} (SSE) for live per-file progress.
SSE endpoint — streams job state once per second until done/error.
List contents of a directory for the browser UI. Returns JSON with items array containing {name, type, path} objects. type is either "folder" or "file".

OpenSubtitles API Python Client ================================ A comprehensive Python class wrapping all endpoints of the OpenSubtitles REST API v1. API Documentation: https://opensubtitles.stoplight.io/docs/opensubtitles-api Base URL: https://api.opensu
Raised when the API returns an error response.

Full-featured Python client for the OpenSubtitles REST API v1. Covers every endpoint group: - Authentication : login, logout - Subtitles : search - Download : request download URL - Features : search features (movies / TV shows) - Discover : popular featur

Create a JWT token to authenticate a user. Automatically stores the returned token for subsequent requests. Also updates base_url if the API returns a different base_url (e.g. vip-api.opensubtitles.com for VIP users). Rate limit: 1 req/s, 10 req/min, 30 re
Destroy the current user session/token. Clears the locally stored token after a successful call. Returns: dict with keys: message, status.
Get all supported subtitle file formats (GET /infos/formats). Returns: dict with a list of supported format strings.
Get all supported languages with their codes (GET /infos/languages). Returns: dict with data[] containing language_code and language_name.

Get available AI translation APIs and their supported languages (GET /ai/info/translation). No authentication required. Returns: dict with data[] containing name, display_name, description, pricing, reliability, price, languages_supported[].

Get available AI transcription APIs and their supported languages (GET /ai/info/transcription). No authentication required. Returns: dict with data[] containing name, display_name, description, pricing, reliability, price, languages_supported[].

Get information about the currently authenticated user (GET /infos/user). Requires bearer token (login first). Returns: dict with data containing: allowed_downloads, level, user_id, vip, downloads_count, remaining_downloads.
Get the AI credits balance for the authenticated user (GET /ai/credits). Requires Api-Key and Authorization header. Returns: dict with data.credits (integer).
Get available credit packages with checkout URLs (GET /ai/credits/buy). Returns: dict with data[] containing name, value, discount_percent, checkout_url.

Get the status of a transcription job (GET /ai/transcribe/{correlation_id}). Status values: CREATED | PENDING | COMPLETED | ERROR | TIMEOUT Args: correlation_id: The correlation_id returned by ai_transcribe(). Returns: dict with job status details.

Get the status of a translation job (GET /ai/translate/{correlation_id}). Status values: CREATED | PENDING | COMPLETED | ERROR | TIMEOUT Args: correlation_id: The correlation_id returned by ai_translate(). Returns: dict with job status details.

Extract metadata from a video filename using the GuessIt library (GET /utilities/guessit). Works for both movies and TV show episodes. Args: filename: The video filename to analyse (e.g. "movie.2023.1080p.mkv"). Returns: dict with keys: title, year, langua

Detect the language of a subtitle file (POST /ai/detect_language_text). At least 1 AI credit is required. Args: file: Path to the subtitle file (str) or raw bytes. Returns: dict with data.format, data.type, data.language (W3C, name, native, ISO_639_1, ISO_

Get the status of a detect-language-audio job (GET /ai/detect_language_audio/{correlation_id}). Status values: CREATED | PENDING | COMPLETED | ERROR | TIMEOUT Args: correlation_id: The correlation_id returned by detect_language_audio(). Returns: dict with

Compute the OpenSubtitles movie hash for a local video file. The hash is a 16-character hex string derived from the file size and the first/last 64 KB of the file content. Args: file_path: Absolute or relative path to the video file. Returns: 16-character
